prompt:
Tall Grass Portrait

[SUBJECT], lying in tall grass, shot from directly above, the grass bending slightly in wind around them, eyes open looking up at the camera or at the sky, late afternoon light warm and low-angled, the grass casting fine shadow lines across the body, fine grain, color grade of deep green and golden straw, the world reduced to one person.

promptZh:
高草丛中的肖像

[SUBJECT]，躺在高草丛中，从正上方俯拍，草丛随风轻微弯曲，双眼睁开看向镜头或天空，午后温暖的低角度光线，草丛在身上投下细腻的阴影线条，带有胶片颗粒感，深绿色与金黄色稻草的色调，整个世界仿佛只剩下一个人。
